reason: The hypothesis applies active-learning ML potentials, already demonstrated for melting simulations of high-entropy carbonitrides (P2, P3) and for mechanical properties of refractory MPEAs (P6, P7), to the specific problem of thermodynamic integration for free energies of refractory HEAs. While the individual components (active learning, ML potentials, thermodynamic integration) are known, the specific combination to address the EAM reference limitation in TOR-TILD for liquid-phase free energies is a direct extension of existing work rather than a novel synthesis or a resolution of a conflict.
